rows.en: It has been one week since Representative Peacecraft, Earth's new leader, announced that space refugees would be accepted.
A transport carrying refugees who have wandered through space is now about to enter the atmosphere.
After a long war, Earth and space are joining hands once more, and a new era is about to begin.
This appears to be a UCE warship!
The shuttles carrying the refugees are under attack!
UCE forces have attacked a refugee ship again!
